title: Reinforcement Learning for Controller Parameters in the Auto-Bidding System at Pinterest
abstract: arXiv:2610.33248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Auto-bidding systems in online advertising must balance competing objectives-maximizing budget delivery while minimizing cost per action-across heterogeneous campaigns under non-stationary market conditions. This trade-off evolves over campaign lifespans: early on, cost optimization dominates when budgets roll over; near deadlines, budget delivery becomes urgent. While PID controllers are widely used in production for their stability and interpretability, fixed tunings cannot adapt to diverse campaigns and shifting traffic patterns. We present RLBP (Reinforcement Learning for Bidding Parameters), a hybrid architecture deployed at Pinterest that uses RL as a meta-controller to select campaign-specific PID parameters daily while retaining PID for high-frequency bid adjustments. translated_abstract: 在线广告中的自动竞价系统必须在非平稳的市场条件下，针对异构的广告活动平衡相互竞争的目标——在最大化预算消耗的同时最小化单次行为成本。这种权衡会随广告活动的生命周期而演变：早期在预算可以结转时，成本优化占主导地位；而在临近截止日期时，预算消耗则变得紧迫。虽然PID控制器因其稳定性和可解释性在生产环境中被广泛使用，但固定的调优参数无法适应多样化的广告活动和不断变化的流量模式。我们提出了RLBP（竞价参数强化学习），这是一种部署在Pinterest的混合架构，它使用强化学习作为元控制器每日为每个广告活动选择特定的PID参数，同时保留PID用于高频的竞价调整。RLBP使用相对于生产基线进行归一化的相对提升奖励公式来训练多头Q网络，并在推理时执行融合……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种部署在Pinterest的混合架构RLBP，以强化学习作为元控制器每日为各广告活动动态选择PID控制器参数，解决了传统固定PID调参无法适应多样化广告活动与非平稳市场条件的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents RLBP, a hybrid architecture deployed at Pinterest that uses reinforcement learning as a meta-controller to select campaign-specific PID parameters daily, addressing the inability of fixed PID tunings to adapt to diverse campaigns and non-stationary market conditions.
